items.title: Mr. and Mrs. A.C. Synigal and B. Bozant Interview, 1962-05-17
items.q: Buck Johnson came in the band. He organized the band. Called Buck Johnson's band.

ctx.x: And what bands did you hear in New Iberia as you were growing up?

Well, in New Iberia at that time we had a band composed of the accordion. Oh, yeah. Mostly accordion music. That's the band there, accordion music and the guitar. Guitar and accordion. Yes. And finally we went on up to the halls, you know. Started to go in the halls. And Buck Johnson came in the band. He organized the band. Called Buck Johnson's band. So he started. And then he came in with the halls and the sliding tramboles and the brass band. That was after accordion and the guitar. And we had balls after…
What about those accordion players and guitar players? Do you remember any of their names?
